neighbours.label: In a text that opens mid-sentence (a lowercase fragment starting in the middle of a clause, with no complete sentence before it), the word that fills the phrase's last open slot: a verb after 'before' or 'to', a participle after 'be' or 'keep', or the object noun that completes a verb phrase. The same phrase-finishing words stay low when the text opens with a complete, capitalized sentence.
neighbours.short: phrase-finishing word in a text that opens mid-sentence
neighbours.notes: Cold arm of the deep-cell experiment: labelled from its own tops and probes only. Card flags it broad (2.9% of tokens >0.1 max) and positional (tops cluster ~4 tokens into the window). Fragment vs full-sentence twins split 5/6 in probes, but fragments only reached 0.15-0.44; solver showed a top full sentence ('haven't figured out') at 0.74 and a 0.34 leak on 'before' late in a passage. Sentences written blind by a second author from the label only.
